classification.difficultyReason: Cube the given length scale factor, calculate an original cube or prism volume where needed, and choose multiplication or division according to which volume is unknown. Part a supplies the ratio-table scaffold; later parts require applying that routine independently.

content.prompt: Given that the following pairs of solids are similar, find the unknown volume using the information given. Round to 2 d.p. where appropriate.

spec.description: Original cube left and enlarged cube right, with a rightward arrow labelled k=1.4. Original front edge is 5 cm; volumes are V₁ and V₂. Each front square has matching equal-edge ticks.
spec.mathematics: Each cube shows front, top and right faces with depth directed upwards and rightwards. Corresponding drawn lengths have ratio 1:1.4. Equality ticks lie on all four front edges of each cube.
spec.answerVisibility: V₁, V₂, 5 cm and k=1.4 are permanent givens. No volume answers are drawn.

spec.description: Paired rectangular prisms, original left and image right. Original dimensions are height 3 cm, front width 6 cm and depth 4 cm. A rightward arrow labelled k=2.1 links V₁ to V₂.
spec.mathematics: Front, top and right faces are visible. Labels are attached to the original vertical, front horizontal and receding depth edges. Dimensions are source givens; image drawing is schematic.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimension labels, volume symbols and scale factor are permanent givens.

spec.description: Two similar solids, each a cone joined to a cylinder at their common circular rim. Original V₁ is left; image V₂=230 cm³ is right. Rightward enlargement arrow is labelled k=4/3.
spec.mathematics: Apex joins the left and right endpoints of the cone-cylinder rim. The front rim arc is visible; its rear half is occluded by the cone. The cylinder has two silhouette generators and a visible front bottom arc. No unspecified dimensions or hidden rear edges are added.
spec.answerVisibility: Scale factor and image volume are givens; original volume remains unknown.

spec.description: Two similar composite solids made from a smaller rectangular block on a larger rectangular block. Original V₁ is left; enlarged image V₂=876 cm³ is right. The enlargement arrow is labelled k=2.4.
spec.mathematics: Both solids use the same front-top-right view. The upper block rests on the base top face, inset from its front and side edges. The base front, right and exposed top faces remain visible. Covered base-top segments are omitted. No individual dimensions are added; schematic display size does not assert extra measurements.
spec.answerVisibility: V₁, V₂=876 cm³ and k=2.4 are permanent givens.
